notes.title: Signup to mailing list
notes.content:
Signup for emails about new features, betas, discounts, price change announcements and other news about VR apps by Reality Inside:
[list]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844610/Reality_Mixer__Mixed_Reality_for_Vive_and_Index/]Reality Mixer[/url]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1617770/Cam_Circle_VR/]Cam Circle VR[/url]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1196450/Stop_Sign_VR_Tools/]Stop Sign VR Tools[/url]
[*]more to come...
[/list]
You'll get an email only sporadically and your address won't be used for anything else.
